verification.environment: custom-autorace:noetic Docker image; isolated --network none container
verification.actual_ros_smoke_scope: Real imports, initialization, one cmd_vel publisher, zero commands while sensors are absent; no driving

limitations: No Gazebo driving of the port or official-start ordered-course validation was performed.
No physical robot validation was performed; footprint is the source custom robot, not a measured TB body.
The odom anchor assumes the configured surveyed entry pose. TB camera disappearance does not establish that pose; portal registration was not ported.
The port uses live LiDAR mapping and source keep-in geometry, not the source static wall map or AMCL.
Ideal closed-loop tests do not reproduce the actual Gazebo tunnel obstacles, sensor noise, delays, wheel slip, or real camera lane recovery.
